list.name: pipeline_id
list.query: SELECT pipeline_id FROM pipeline ORDER BY pipeline_id

list.name: namespace
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_array_elements(components_json)->>'namespace' AS namespace FROM pipeline WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

list.name: log_pod_regex
list.description: Narrows the Logs panel to just this pipeline's pod(s), derived from component_run.external_id (the real CR/pod name the collectors already track) - not just the shared k8s namespace, which can hold unrelated pods (e.g. sparkpi_sample's 'default' namespace also hosts minio-operator and superset). Falls back to '.*' (no pod narrowing) for pipelines with no discrete pod of their own - e.g. Airflow-orchestrated pipelines whose tasks run inside the shared airflow-scheduler/dag-processor pods - where log_content_regex does the narrowing instead.
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(type IN ('spark','flink')) THEN string_agg(DISTINCT split_part(external_id,'/',2), '|') FILTER (WHERE type IN ('spark','flink')) WHEN bool_or(type = 'nifi') THEN string_agg(DISTINCT external_id, '|') FILTER (WHERE type = 'nifi') ELSE '.*' END FROM component_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

list.name: log_content_regex
list.description: Line-content filter used only when log_pod_regex can't narrow to a discrete pod (Airflow-orchestrated pipelines) - matches this pipeline's dag_id, which appears literally in the shared scheduler/dag-processor pods' log lines.
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN bool_and(type = 'airflow') THEN '$pipeline_id' ELSE '.*' END FROM component_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

panels.title: Quick actions
panels.description: Cross-links to related dashboards and this pipeline's native UI/registry file for the currently-selected $pipeline_id.

options.content: **Registry:** `registry/$pipeline_id.yaml`  |  [Pipeline Overview](/d/pipeline-overview)  |  [Pipeline SLA](/d/pipeline-sla)  |  [Data Lineage for $pipeline_id](/d/data-lineage?var-pipeline_id=$pipeline_id)  |  **Native UIs:** [Airflow](http://192.168.2.100:30081) · [NiFi](https://192.168.2.100:30443/nifi) · [Marquez](http://192.168.2.100:30501/)  |  Spark History Server / Trino / per-job Flink REST UIs are ClusterIP-only in this environment (no external NodePort) - use `ui_url` in the component table below for their in-cluster address, or `kubectl port-forward`.

panels.title: Current status
panels.description: Status of this pipeline's most recent run (pipeline_run), regardless of when it started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(pr.status, 'unknown') AS status FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) pr ON true WHERE p.pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

panels.title: SLA status
panels.description: This pipeline's current SLA state from pipeline_current_sla_status - the worst currently-active rule, not a historical count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sla.overall_result, 'ok') AS sla_status FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN pipeline_current_sla_status sla ON sla.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

panels.title: Owner / Tier
panels.description: Registered owning team and priority tier (P1/P2/P3) from the pipeline registry (pipeline.owner, pipeline.tier).

targets.rawSql: SELECT owner || ' / ' || tier AS owner_tier FROM pipeline WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

panels.title: SLA target
panels.description: The configured SLA threshold for this pipeline (max duration or freshness target) from pipeline.sla_json - what "breached" is measured against.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sla_json->>'max_duration_minutes', sla_json->>'freshness_target_minutes', 'n/a') || CASE WHEN sla_json ? 'max_duration_minutes' THEN ' min max duration' WHEN sla_json ? 'freshness_target_minutes' THEN ' min freshness' ELSE '' END AS sla_target FROM pipeline WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id'

panels.title: Last successful run
panels.description: Timestamp of this pipeline's most recent status='success' run - shows "never succeeded" instead of a bare no-data state for pipelines that have no discrete success event (e.g. continuous streaming pipelines that stay 'running' forever, or a deliberately-broken demo pipeline).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(to_char(max(ended_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'never succeeded') AS last_success FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' AND status = 'success'

panels.title: Duration trend vs SLA threshold (30d)
panels.description: Each run's duration_s over the last 30 days plotted against the pipeline's configured max_duration_minutes SLA threshold, so a slow drift toward breach is visible before it actually breaches.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, duration_s FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' AND started_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY started_at

SELECT started_at AS time, (SELECT (sla_json->>'max_duration_minutes')::float * 60 FROM pipeline WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id') AS sla_threshold_s FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' AND started_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Run history (30d)
panels.description: Raw pipeline_run rows for this pipeline over the last 30 days, most recent first - the audit trail behind the summary stat tiles above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at, ended_at, status, round(duration_s) AS duration_s, trigger, error_summary FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' AND started_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Component breakdown (stage status)
panels.description: This is the swimlane: each row is one stage (NiFi/Spark/Flink/Airflow task) with current status, color-coded. Direct link to each component's native UI where available (ui_url) - Grafana is the correlation layer, not a replacement for the Spark/Flink/Airflow UIs (plan §7).

targets.rawSql: SELECT type, external_id, status, started_at, ended_at, retry_count, ui_url FROM component_run WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: DQ checklist for this pipeline's datasets
panels.description: Latest dq_result rows for datasets this pipeline produces - pass/warn/fail per check, independent of whether the pipeline_run itself succeeded (a pipeline can report success while its output data fails quality checks).

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, check_name, dimension, status, observed, threshold, evaluated_at FROM dq_result WHERE pipeline_id = '$pipeline_id' ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Logs for this pipeline's job
panels.description: Filtered down to this pipeline's actual pod(s) (log_pod_regex, from component_run.external_id), not just its shared k8s namespace - a namespace can hold unrelated workloads (e.g. sparkpi_sample's 'default' namespace also runs minio-operator and superset). For Airflow-orchestrated pipelines with no discrete pod of their own, falls back to matching the dag_id in the shared scheduler/dag-processor logs (log_content_regex). Shows the extracted log message text, not fluentbit's raw JSON envelope. Not correlated by run_id: these demo jobs print plain-text logs, not structured logs carrying a run_id field - true one-click run_id correlation is a follow-up once real pipelines emit structured logs.
